03002.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Analytical Mind, The King in Yellow (Act 1), 1 random basic weakness.
03002.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-2。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：缜密分析、黄衣之王(第一幕)、1张随机基础弱点。
03002.flavor: "You can depend on me to guide you through the unknown."
03002.flavorZh: “相信我，我可以带你穿越未知的领域。”
03002.name: 潘明
03002.text:
[reaction] After an investigator at your location commits a card to a skill test: That card gains a [wild] icon until the end of the test. (Limit once for each investigator per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may choose a skill card committed to this skill test to return to its owner's hand after this test ends.
03002.textZh:
[reaction]你所在地点的调查员在技能检定中投入一张卡牌后：直到本次技能检定结束，该卡牌获得一个[wild]图标。(每位调查员每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。本次技能检定结束后，你可以选择投入本次技能检定的一张技能卡牌返回其所有者的手牌。

03003.backFlavor: Even when she was young, Sefina's alluring paintings drew the eyes of many. When an art collector from Paris visited Tahiti and discovered Sefina, he offered to support her work in exchange for her services creating imitations. Her keen eye and steady hand were perfect for the task, and Sefina found the art of forgery to be more engaging and captivating than she'd imagined. Her most recent work came from an anonymous stranger with deep pockets, who'd tasked her with recreating a panorama of a strange, alien city. When she completed the final stroke, she was sent hurtling into the world of the painting. She only barely survived the ordeal, passing out from exhaustion. When she awoke in her gallery, she knew it had been real.
03003.backFlavorZh: 打小开始，赛菲娜漂亮的画就吸引了许多人的眼球。后来，一位巴黎的艺术收藏家来到塔希提岛，发现了赛菲娜，给了她一份工作，但要求她为他绘制赝品。赛菲娜敏锐的眼光和稳健的巧手让她成为这份工作不二的人选，而她也发现造假工艺比她想象中更能激发她的热情。最近一位腰缠万贯的匿名陌生人给了她一份活，要她重绘出一座奇怪的异星城市的全景图。当她完成最后一笔时，她猛地被拖入了画中的世界。筋疲力竭之下，她昏厥了过去，差一点当场暴毙。她醒来时，已身处自己的画室，这时她知道，一切都是真实的。
03003.backText:
Deck Size: 33.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of The Painted World, 1 copy of Stars of Hyades, 1 random basic weakness.
03003.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：33。
牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-2。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：3张画中世界、1张毕宿星团、1张随机基础弱点。
03003.name: 赛菲娜·卢梭
03003.text:
Forced - When you would draw your opening hand: Draw 13 cards, instead. Choose up to 5 events to place beneath this card and keep 8 cards as your opening hand. Discard the rest. (You cannot mulligan.)
[action]: Choose an event beneath this card and draw it. Does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[elder_sign] effect: +3. You may choose an event beneath this card and draw it.
03003.textZh:
强制 - 在你将要抽取起始手牌时：改为抽取13张卡牌。选择最多5张事件放在本卡牌底下，并保留8张卡牌作为你的起始手牌。弃掉其余卡牌。(你不能重调。)
[action]：选择并抽取本卡牌底下的一张事件。不会触发趁乱攻击。
[elder_sign]效果：+3。你可以选择并抽取本卡牌底下的一张事件。

03004.backFlavor: As a young girl in Nigeria, Akachi became used to being set apart. Her habits of chattering away at thin air and secluding herself from other children led her village to believe she was mad. Her village Dibia was the first to see her true potential. He believed Akachi was marked by the spirits for greatness, and he taught her how to commune with them to her advantage. Under his tutelage, Akachi grew into a wise young leader, respected not just in her village, but in every community she aided. Now she meets her destiny head on, seeking out unnatural troubles that only her knowledge can stop.
03004.backFlavorZh: 阿喀琦来自尼日利亚，她从小就和他人格格不入。她经常与空气对话，也不和其他孩子一起玩耍，所以村里人觉得她疯了。而村子的先知第一个发现了她的潜力。他相信神灵选中了阿喀琦是需要她去成就大事，于是他教会了她如何发挥潜力与神灵交流。在他的教导下，阿喀琦迅速成长为一名年轻睿智的领袖，不仅她所在的村子，所有她帮助过的社群都对她尊敬有加。现在她要踏上征途，运用她独有的知识去解决那些只有她能解决的非自然问题。
03004.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards with "uses (charges)" level 0-4, [[Occult]] cards level 0.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Spirit-Speaker, Angered Spirits, 1 random basic weakness.
03004.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，带有“使用(充能)”的卡牌等级0-4，[[密教]]卡牌等级0。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：灵言者、怒灵、1张随机基础弱点。
03004.flavor: "I will journey to the lands beyond. I do not fear them."
03004.flavorZh:
“我会渡越彼岸。
我不惧怕它们。”
03004.name: 阿喀琦·奥耶莉
03004.text:
Your assets with "uses (charges)" enter play with 1 additional charge on them.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Add 1 charge to an asset with "uses (charges)" you control.
03004.textZh:
你带有“使用(充能)”的支援入场时带有额外1点充能。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。你控制的一张带有“使用(充能)”的支援增加1点充能。

03005.backFlavor: William Yorick never wanted to be a gravedigger. He had trained to be an actor and had worked for years in Boston, taking whatever parts were available. Shakespeare was the best stuff, of course, but after many years and hardly any roles, he was forced to admit that the stage was not his destiny. Digging graves was tedious work, but the dead made for an excellent audience, and William always did love a soliloquy. The job took a dark turn when he found degenerate creatures eating the dead in their graves. Ever since that night, Yorick has kept the creatures at bay, using whatever means he can to protect the dead.
03005.backFlavorZh: 威廉·约里克从没想过要当一个挖墓人。他早年学习演艺，在波士顿当了多年演员，承接所有角色。莎士比亚的剧当然精彩，但是过了那么多年却没有接到几个角色的他也不得不承认舞台不是他的归宿。挖墓是一件沉闷的工作，但死者却是最好的观众，而威廉最喜欢的就是戏剧独白。但当他发现一群堕落的生物在啃食墓地里的尸体时，一切又变得不同了。自从那一晚起，为了保护死者，约里克用尽了各种手段驱赶那些生物。
03005.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bury Them Deep, Graveyard Ghouls, 1 random basic weakness.
03005.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-2。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：挖土深埋、墓地食尸鬼、1张随机基础弱点。
03005.flavor: "I am but a simple player in this drama, but if I am lucky, I'll live to see the curtains fall."
03005.flavorZh: “我不过是这场剧中的一个演员，但如果运气好，我会活着看到落幕。”
03005.name: 威廉·约里克
03005.text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Play an asset from your discard pile (paying its cost). (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. If this test is successful, return 1 card from your discard pile to your hand.
03005.textZh:
[reaction]在你击败敌人后：从你的弃牌堆(支付其费用)打出一张支援。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。如果本次检定成功，将你弃牌堆中的1张卡牌返回你的手牌。

03006.backFlavor: Lola has performed to sold-out houses worldwide, but no play has been as haunting or as odd as The King in Yellow. Even during rehearsals, everything about it brought calamity and dread. When her co-star, Miriam, was found floating dead in the Seine, she decided she'd had enough, and penned a letter to the director explaining that her next performance would be her last. Now she heads home to Arkham for one final show, hoping she can finally be rid of this dreadful play.
03006.backFlavorZh: 萝拉在全球各地出演剧目时，戏票每每都被抢购一空，但从没有一部剧像《黄衣之王》一般不详而诡异。就连排练期间，戏班子都连遭厄运。一天，与她联袂出演的米里亚姆被人发现浮尸于塞纳河上，她终于崩溃了，提笔写下辞职信，告诉导演下一场就是自己的告别演出。现在她回到自己的家乡阿卡姆，准备最后一次演出，她也希望这一次能永远告别这出可怕的戏剧。
03006.backText:
Deck Size: 35.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor, Guardian, Seeker, Rogue, and Mystic cards ([survivor], [guardian], [seeker], [rogue], and [mystic]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of Improvisation, 2 copies of Crisis of Identity, 1 random basic weakness.
Additional Requirements: Your deck must include at least 7 cards each from 3 different classes ([survivor], [guardian], [seeker], [rogue], or [mystic]).
03006.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：35。
牌库构建选项：求生者、守卫者、探求者、流浪者和潜修者卡牌([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：2张即兴表演、2张身份危机、1张随机基础弱点。
附加需求：你的牌库必须包含3个不同职阶([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic])，每个职阶至少7张卡牌。

deckOptions.error: You must have at least 7 cards from 3 different factions

03006.flavor: Perhaps this would be her big comeback.
03006.flavorZh: 也许这次是她东山再起的最好时机。
03006.name: 萝拉·海耶斯
03006.text:
Forced - After you draw your opening hand: Choose a role ([survivor], [guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or Neutral).
You can only play, commit, or trigger abilities on Neutral cards or cards of your role.
[fast]: Switch your role. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may switch roles.
03006.textZh:
强制 - 你抽取起始手牌后：选择一个角色([survivor]、[guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]或中立)。
你能打出、投入或触发能力的卡牌只限于中立卡牌和你所选角色的卡牌。
[free]：切换你的角色。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以切换角色。

03007.flavor: The real war has only just begun.
03007.flavorZh: 真正的战争现在才开始。
03007.name: 保卫后方
03007.text:
Mark Harrigan deck only.
If this skill test is successful during an attack, move 1 damage from Mark Harrigan to the attacked enemy.
03007.textZh:
马克·哈里根牌库专用。
如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，将马克哈里根上的1点伤害移动到被攻击敌人上。

03008.name: 炮弹休克
03008.text: Revelation - For every 2 damage on you, take 1 horror.
03008.textZh: 显现 - 你身上每有2点伤害，受到1点恐惧。

03009.backTextZh:
索菲不能离场。
你的每项技能-1。
强制 - 如果马克·哈里根身上有4点或更少伤害：将索菲翻面。
03009.name: 索菲
03009.text:
Mark Harrigan deck only.
Sophie cannot leave play.
[fast] Take 1 direct damage: You get +2 to your skill value for this skill test.
Forced - If Mark Harrigan has 5 or more damage on him: Flip Sophie.
03009.textZh:
马克·哈里根牌库专用。
索菲不能离场。
[free]受到1点直接伤害：你本次技能检定得到技能值+2。
强制 - 如果马克·哈里根身上有5点或更多伤害：将索菲翻面。

03009b.name: 索菲
03009b.text:
Sophie cannot leave play.
You get -1 to each of your skills.
Forced - If Mark Harrigan has 4 or less damage on him: Flip Sophie.
03009b.textZh:
索菲不能离场。
你得到每项技能-1。
强制 - 如果马克·哈里根身上有4点或更少伤害：将索菲翻面。

03010.name: 缜密分析
03010.text:
Minh Thi Phan deck only.
You may commit 1 card to each skill test performed by an investigator at another location.
[reaction] After you commit exactly 1 card to a skill test, exhaust Analytical Mind: Draw 1 card.
03010.textZh:
潘明牌库专用。
每次其他地点的调查员执行技能检定，你都可以投入1张卡牌。
[reaction]你在技能检定中投入正好1张卡牌后，横置缜密分析：抽取1张卡牌。

03011.name: 黄衣之王
03011.text:
Revelation - Put The King in Yellow into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except through the [reaction] ability below.
You cannot commit exactly 1 or 2 cards to a skill test.
[reaction] After a skill test is successful in which Minh Thi Phan has committed at least 6 matching skill icons for that test: Discard The King in Yellow.
03011.textZh:
显现 - 将黄衣之王放置入场，放到你的威胁区城。除非通过以下[reaction]能力，否则它不能离场。
你不能在技能检定中投入正好1或2张卡牌。
[reaction]技能检定成功且潘明投入至少6个与该次检定对应的技能图标后：弃掉黄衣之王。

03012.name: 画中世界
03012.text:
Sefina Rousseau deck only.
Cannot be placed beneath Sefina Rousseau.
Play The Painted World as an exact copy of a non-exceptional event that is beneath Sefina Rousseau. Remove The Painted World from the game instead of discarding it.
03012.textZh:
赛菲娜·卢梭牌库专用。
不能放在赛菲娜·卢梭底下。
将画中世界作为赛菲娜·卢梭底下的一张非卓越事件打出。不要弃掉画中世界，改为将其从游戏中移除。

03013.name: 毕宿星团
03013.text: Revelation - Randomly choose an event beneath Sefina Rousseau and remove it from the game. If you cannot, take 1 damage and 1 horror. If your deck has 5 or more cards in it, shuffle Stars of Hyades back into your deck instead of discarding it.
03013.textZh: 显现 - 随机选择赛菲娜·卢梭底下的一张事件，将其从游戏中移除。如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。如果你的牌库有5张或以上卡牌，不要弃掉毕宿星团，改为将其洗回你的牌库。

03014.name: 灵言者
03014.text:
Akachi Onyele deck only.
[fast] Exhaust Spirit-Speaker: Choose an asset you control with "uses (charges)." Either return that asset to your hand, or move all charges from that asset to your resource pool (as resources) and discard that asset.
03014.textZh:
阿喀琦·奥耶莉牌库专用。
[free]横置灵言者：选择你控制的一张带有“使用(充能)”的支援。将该支援返回你的手牌，或将该支援上的所有充能(作为资源)移动到你的资源池井弃掉该支援。

03015.name: 怒灵
03015.text:
Revelation - Put Angered Spirits into play in your threat area.
[fast] Exhaust a [[Spell]] asset: Move 1 charge from that asset to Angered Spirits.
Forced - When the game ends, if Angered Spirits has fewer than 4 charges on it: You suffer 1 physical trauma.
03015.textZh:
显现 - 将怒灵放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
[free]横置一张[[法术]]支援：将该支援上的1充能移动到怒灵上。
强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果怒灵上的充能少于4：你承受1点肉体创伤。

03016.flavor:
"Though this be madness, yet there is method in 't."
- William Shakespeare, Hamlet.
03016.flavorZh: “这些虽然是疯话，却有深意在内。”威廉·莎士比亚，《哈姆雷特》
03016.name: 挖土深埋
03016.text:
William Yorick deck only.
Fast. Play after a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location is defeated.
Add that enemy (and this card) to the victory display.
03016.textZh:
威廉·约里克牌库专用。
快速。你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人被击败后打出。
将该敌人(和本卡牌)加入胜利区。

03017.flavor:
"Hell is empty and all the devils are here."
 - William Shakespeare, The Tempest
03017.flavorZh: “地狱空荡荡，魔鬼在人间。”威廉·莎士比亚，《暴风雨》
03017.name: 墓地食尸鬼
03017.text:
Prey - William Yorick only.
Hunter.
While Graveyard Ghouls is engaged with you, cards cannot leave your discard pile.
03017.textZh:
猎物 - 仅对威廉·约里克。
猎手。
墓地食尸鬼与你交战时，你弃牌堆中的卡牌不能离开弃牌堆。

03018.name: 即兴表演
03018.text:
Lola Hayes deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Switch your role. Until the end of your turn, reduce the resource cost of the next card you play of your role by 3. Draw 1 card.
03018.textZh:
萝拉·海耶斯牌库专用。
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
切换你的角色。直到你的回合结束，你打出的下一张你所选角色的卡牌资源费用减少3点。抽取1张卡牌。

03019.flavor: "I've played so many roles. Madness is to be expected."
03019.flavorZh: “我演过那么多角色，就算疯了也是正常的。”
03019.name: 身份危机
03019.text: Revelation - Discard all cards you control of your current role. Then, discard the top card of your deck. Switch your role to the class of the discarded card (if the discarded card is a weakness, switch your role to neutral).
03019.textZh: 显现 - 弃掉你控制的全部你当前角色的卡牌。然后，弃掉你牌库顶1张卡牌。将你的角色切换到该弃掉的卡牌职阶(如果弃掉的卡牌是弱点，切换到中立角色)。

03020.flavor: Even after the introduction of the semi-automatic, many police officers and private gun owners preferred the reliability of a revolver.
03020.flavorZh: 虽然发明了半自动枪械，但许多警官和私有枪支持有者仍然相信左轮手枪更为可靠。
03020.name: .32柯尔特手枪
03020.text:
Uses (6 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You deal +1 damage for this attack.
03020.textZh:
使用(6子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击造成+1伤害。

03021.name: 勇气过人
03021.text: True Grit may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.
03021.textZh: 你所在地点的其他调查员受到的伤害可以分配给勇气过人。

03022.name: “放着我来！”
03022.text:
Fast. Play after another investigator draws a non-peril encounter card, but before resolving that card's effects.
You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead. You get +2 to each of your skills while resolving that card's revelation effect.
03022.textZh:
快速。另一位调查员抽取了一张非险境遭遇卡牌后，结算该卡牌效果前打出。
改为视为你抽取了该遭遇卡牌。结算该卡牌的显现效果时，你得到每项技能+2。

03023.flavor:
He had to give Logan credit:
the man knew how to gear up for Armageddon.
03023.flavorZh: 不得不说，洛根这家伙对世界末日真的留了一手。
03023.name: 时刻警惕
03023.text: One at a time, play up to 3 assets from your hand, reducing the resource cost of each by 1.
03023.textZh: 依次从你手中打出最多3张支援，每张资源费用减少1点。

03024.flavor: If this didn't get Gené into the Explorers Club, nothing would.
03024.flavorZh: 要是这都不能让吉尼进入探险家俱乐部，那就没可能了。
03024.name: 实地调查
03024.text: [reaction] After you move to a location, if that location has at least 1 clue on it, exhaust Fieldwork: You get +2 skill value for the next skill test you perform this phase.
03024.textZh: [reaction]你移动到一个地点后，如果该地点至少有1个线索，横置实地调查：本阶段你执行的下一次技能检定得到技能值+2。

03025.name: 古代雕文
03025.text:
[action] Discard a card with at least 1 [intellect] skill icon from your hand: Place 1 resource on Archaic Glyphs from the token pool, as a secret.
Forced - After the third secret is placed on Archaic Glyphs: Discard Archaic Glyphs and gain 5 resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have translated the glyphs."
03025.textZh:
[action]弃掉你手牌中一张含有至少1个[intellect]技能图标的卡牌：从供应堆拿取1资源放到古代雕文上，作为秘密。
强制 - 第三个秘密放到古代雕文上后：弃掉古代雕文并获得5资源。在你的剧本日志上记录下“你翻译出了雕文”。

03026.name: 殚精竭虑
03026.text: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 6 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.
03026.textZh: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库顶6张卡牌，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。

03027.name: 掌握内幕
03027.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate. Investigate any revealed location in play as if you were at that location.
03027.textZh:
使用(3秘密)。
[action]花费1秘密：调查。调查场上任意一个已揭示的地点，如同你在该地点。

03028.name: 潜行
03028.text: [action] Exhaust Stealth: Evade. The chosen enemy gets -2 evade for this evasion attempt. If you successfully evade the enemy, disengage with it but do not exhaust it. Until the end of your turn, that enemy cannot engage you.
03028.textZh: [action]横置潜行：躲避。所选敌人本次躲避尝试得到-2躲避。如果你成功躲避该敌人，与它解除交战但不要横置它。直到你回合结束，该敌人不能与你交战。

03029.name: 障眼戏法
03029.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Put an [[Item]] asset into play from your hand. At the end of your turn, if that asset is still in play, return it to your hand.
03029.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
将你手牌中的一张[[道具]]支援放置入场。当你的回合结束时，如果该支援依然在场，将其返回你手牌。

03030.flavor:
"McGlen, are you tryin' to get us both killed?"
"Not this time, pal. Not this time."
03030.flavorZh:
“麦克格林，你想让我们两个都送命吗？”
“这次不会了，伙计。这次不会了。”
03030.name: 艺高胆大
03030.text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +2 skill value for this test.
03030.textZh:
快速。在你技能检定将要成功时打出。
你本次检定得到+2技能值。

03031.name: 撬锁工具
03031.text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.
03031.textZh:
使用(3补给)。如果撬锁工具没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]横置撬锁工具：调查。本次调查将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从撬锁工具移除1补给。

03032.name: 炼金转化
03032.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Alchemical Transmutation, spend 1 charge: Test [willpower] (1). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 3). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, take 1 damage.
03032.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]横置炼金转化，花费1充能：检定[willpower](1)。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，获得1资源(最多3个)。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点伤害。

03033.flavor:
The power seized her, made her shudder and spasm.
Its energy united with hers, and then,
she opened her eyes…
03033.flavorZh:
力量攫获了她，让她浑身战栗，痉挛。
能量与她融为一体，然后，
她睁开了双眼……
03033.name: 解锢灵魂
03033.text: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card from your hand, reducing its resource cost by 3.
03033.textZh: 从你手牌打出一张[[法术]]或[[仪式]]卡牌，其资源费用减少3点。

03034.flavor: Extradimensional travel had its risks, he knew. But who could resist the frontiers beyond time and space?
03034.flavorZh:
跨维度的旅行存在风险，这他很清楚。
但谁能抗拒那超越时空的疆域呢？
03034.name: 星界旅行
03034.text: Move. Move to any revealed location and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, you must discard an [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you control (if you cannot, take 1 damage).
03034.textZh: 移动。移动到任意一个已揭示的地点并从混乱袋随机揭示一个标记。如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，你必须弃掉一张你控制的[[道具]]或[[盟友]]支援(如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害)。

03035.name: 灵力祭祀刀
03035.text:
[fast] During a skill test on a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Spirit Athame: You get +2 skill value for this test.
[action] Exhaust Spirit Athame: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack.
03035.textZh:
[free]在[[法术]]卡牌的技能检定期间，横置灵力祭祀刀：你本次检定得到+2技能值。
[action]横置灵力祭祀刀：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。

03036.name: 提灯
03036.text:
[action]: Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation.
[action] Discard Lantern: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
03036.textZh:
[action]：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-1。
[action]弃掉提灯：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

03037.flavor: I knew I should have, but I couldn't stop digging.
03037.flavorZh: 我知道我不应该再挖了，但我就是停不下来。
03037.name: 挖墓人的铲子
03037.text:
[action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack.
[action] Discard Gravedigger's Shovel: Discover 1 clue at your location.
03037.textZh:
[action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。
[action]弃掉挖墓人的铲子：发现你所在地点的1个线索。

03038.name: 藏身地点
03038.text:
Fast. Attach Hiding Spot to any location.
Each non-[[Elite]] enemy at attached location gains aloof.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if a ready enemy is at attached location: Discard Hiding Spot.
03038.textZh:
快速。将藏身地点附属到任意一个地点上。
位于被附属地点的每个非[[精英]]敌人获得冷漠。
强制 - 当敌军阶段结束时，如果有重整敌人在被附属地点：弃掉藏身地点。

03039.name: 急中生智
03039.text: If this skill test is successful, choose a [survivor] card not named Resourceful in your discard pile. Add the chosen card to your hand.
03039.textZh: 如果本次技能检定成功，选择你弃牌堆中一张名称不是急中生智的[survivor]卡牌。将所选卡牌加入你的手牌。

03040.flavor: "Don't worry, I have this completely under control!"
03040.flavorZh: “不要担心，现在局势完全在我掌控之下！”
03040.name: 头脑发热
03040.text: Revelation - Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card gains surge.
03040.textZh: 显现 - 抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。该卡牌获得涌动。

03041.name: 涂绘印记
03041.text:
Revelation - Put Drawing the Sign into play in your threat area.
Your maximum hand size is reduced by 5.
[action] [action]: Discard Drawing the Sign.
03041.textZh:
显现 - 将涂绘印记放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
你的手牌上限减少5张。(FAQ，v1.6)
[action][action]：弃掉涂绘印记。

03042.flavor: To the ends of the earth, and back.
03042.flavorZh: 无论天涯海角，始终不离不弃。
03042.name: 随行鬼影
03042.text:
Spawn - Location farthest from you.
Prey - Bearer only.
Hunter.
Forced - When The Thing That Follows would be defeated: Instead shuffle it into its bearer's deck.
03042.textZh:
生成 - 距离你最远的地点。
猎物 - 仅对承受者。
猎手。
强制 - 在随行鬼影将要被击败时：改为将其洗入承受者的牌库。

03106.name: 英勇救援
03106.text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack another investigator at your location.
Engage that enemy and resolve its attack against you instead. Then, deal it 1 damage.
03106.textZh:
快速。在一个非[[精英]]敌人将要攻击你所在地点的另一位调查员时打出。
改为你与该敌人交战并对你结算它的攻击。然后，对其造成1点伤害。

03107.name: 战斗训练
03107.text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Combat Training before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.
03107.textZh:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给战斗训练。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。

03108.flavor: They are just animals like any other. Or so we thought.
03108.flavorZh: 它们再怎么样也只是动物。但那只是我们的想法。
03108.name: 解剖图表
03108.text:
Fast. Play during any investigator's turn. Play only if you have 5 or more remaining sanity.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Until the end of the active investigator's turn, that enemy gets -2 fight and -2 evade.
03108.textZh:
快速。在任意调查员的回合期间打出。仅当你剩余神智值为5点或以上才可打出。
选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。直到当前调查员的回合结束，该敌人得到-2攻击和-2躲避。

03109.name: 科学理论
03109.text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Scientific Theory before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
03109.textZh:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给科学理论。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。

03110.flavor:
Up close and personal:
just the way Naomi liked it.
03110.flavorZh: 近距离贴身肉搏：内奥米的最爱。
03110.name: 指节铜环
03110.text: [action]: Fight. This attack deals +1 damage. The attacked enemy gains retaliate for this attack.
03110.textZh: [action]：攻击。本次攻击造成+1伤害。被攻击敌人本次攻击获得反击。

03111.name: 刚毅果敢
03111.text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Moxie before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.
03111.textZh:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给刚毅果敢。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。

03112.name: 大卫·伦费尔德
03112.text:
While David Renfield has at least 1 doom on him, you get +1 [willpower].
[fast] Exhaust David Renfield: You may place 1 doom on David Renfield. Gain 1 resource for each doom on David Renfield.
03112.textZh:
大卫·伦费尔德身上有至少1个毁灭标记时，你得到+1[willpower]。
[free]横置大卫伦费尔德：你可以在大卫·伦费尔德身上放置1个毁灭标记。大卫·伦费尔德身上每有一个毁灭标记，获得1资源。

03113.name: 情绪稳定
03113.text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Grounded before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] During a skill test on a [[Spell]] card, spend 1 resource: You get +1 skill value for this test.
03113.textZh:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给情绪稳定。
[free]在[[法术]]卡牌的技能检定期间，花费1资源：你本次检定得到技能值+1。

03114.flavor: Mr. Pawterson always told Wendy things would turn out okay. But then again, Mr. Pawterson was a teddy bear, and he didn't know any better.
03114.flavorZh: 帕特森先生一直告诉温蒂一切都会好起来的。但帕特森先生终究只是一只泰迪熊，他什么都不懂。
03114.name: 珍爱纪念

03115.name: 有胆有识
03115.text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Plucky before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
03115.textZh:
快速。[[沉稳]]卡牌场上仅限1张。
非直接恐惧在分配到你的调查员卡牌之前，必须先分配给有胆有识。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。

03116.name: 临危祷告
03116.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Commit to a skill test only if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
03116.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你剩余神智值为3点或更少才可投入技能检定。

03117.name: 冥思苦想
03117.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Commit to a skill test only if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
03117.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你剩余神智值为3点或更少才可投入技能检定。

03118.name: 拼死出击
03118.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Commit to a skill test only if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
03118.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你剩余神智值为3点或更少才可投入技能检定。

03119.name: 绝命奔逃
03119.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Commit to a skill test only if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
03119.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你剩余神智值为3点或更少才可投入技能检定。

03147.flavor: It’s seen more violence than most people see in a lifetime.
03147.flavorZh: 它经历的暴力事件比大部分人一辈子见过的都要多。
03147.name: 双刃短刀
03147.text:
Engage actions you perform do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[action]: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. X is the number of enemies engaged with you.
03147.textZh:
你执行的交战行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
[action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+X[combat]。X为与你交战的敌人数量。

03148.name: 埋伏
03148.text:
Attach to your location.
If there are no investigators at attached location, discard Ambush.
Forced - After an enemy spawns at attached location: Deal 2 damage to that enemy and discard Ambush.
03148.textZh:
附属到你所在地点。
如果被附属地点没有调查员，弃掉理伏。
强制 - 有敌人生成在被附属地点后：对该敌人造成2点伤害并弃掉埋伏。

03149.name: 查尔斯·罗斯大人
03149.text:
You may spend resources to pay for [[Item]] assets played by other investigators at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Charles Ross, Esq.: Reduce the cost of the next [[Item]] asset played by an investigator at your location by 1.
03149.textZh:
你可以花费资源来支付你所在地点的其他调查员打出的[[道具]]支援。
[free]横置查尔斯·罗斯大人：下一张你所在地点的调查员打出的[[道具]]支援的费用减少1点。

03150.name: 预先警告
03150.text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Place 1 of your clues on your location. Then, cancel that card's revelation effect.
03150.textZh:
快速。在你抽取一张非弱点的诡计卡牌时打出。
将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。然后，取消该卡牌的显现效果。

03151.name: 达里奥·埃尔阿明
03151.text:
While you have 10 or more resources, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[action] If there are no enemies at your location, exhaust Dario El-Amin: Gain 2 resources.
03151.textZh:
你拥有10点或更多资源时，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[action]如果你所在地点没有敌人，横置达里奥·埃尔阿明：获得2资源。

03152.name: 偷袭
03152.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy not engaged with you at your location.
03152.textZh: 对你所在地点的一个未与你交战的敌人造成2点伤害。

03153.name: 灵力风暴
03153.text: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. If you succeed, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed during this attack, deal 1 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.
03153.textZh: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为对该敌人所在地点的每个敌人造成2点伤害(所有额外伤害只对被攻击敌人造成)。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对该敌人所在地点的每位调查员造成1点伤害。(FAQ v2.0)

03154.name: 影之书
03154.text: [action] Exhaust Book of Shadows and spend 1 resource: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.
03154.textZh: [action]横置影之书并花费1资源：为你控制的一个[[法术]]支援增加1充能。

03155.name: 战斗或逃跑
03155.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you get +X [combat] and +X [agility], where X is the amount of horror on you.
03155.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
直到本轮结束，你得到+X[combat]和+X[agility]，其中X为你身上的恐惧数量。

03156.flavor: With or without hope, all you can do is resist.
03156.flavorZh:
无论是否看得到希望，
你所能做的只有抵抗。
03156.name: 意志考验
03156.text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Exile A Test of Will.
03156.textZh:
快速。在你所在地点的一位调查员抽取一张非弱点诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。放逐意志考验。

03157.name: 吉人天相
03157.text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 10 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Exile Devil's Luck.
03157.textZh:
快速。在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
取消你刚受到的伤害和/或恐惧中最多10点。放逐吉人天相。

03158.flavor: "Operator, I’m gonna need you to hang up."
03158.name: 施恩求报
03158.text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset you control and return it to your hand. Then, search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by X. X is the cost of the [[Ally]] asset returned to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
03158.textZh: 选择一张你控制的[[盟友]]支援并将其返回你的手牌。然后，查找你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出1张[[盟友]]支援并将其打出，其费用减少X点。X为返回你手牌的[[盟友]]支援的费用。混洗你的牌库。

03189.flavor: He flicked open the lighter and made his peace.
03189.flavorZh: 他点燃了打火机，内心平静了下来。
03189.name: “同归于尽！”
03189.text: Each non-[[Elite]] enemy engaged with you is defeated. You are defeated and suffer 1 physical trauma. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
03189.textZh: 击败与你交战的每个非[[精英]]敌人。你被击败并承受1点肉体创伤。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

03190.name: .45自动手枪
03190.text:
Uses (4 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Ignore the retaliate keyword for this attack.
03190.textZh:
使用(4子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。本次攻击忽略反击关键词。

03191.flavor:
"I am the wisest man alive, for I know one thing, and that is that I know nothing."
- Plato, <u>The Republic</u>
03191.flavorZh: “我是活着的最智慧的人，因为我知道一件事，那就是我知道我一无所知。”柏拉图，《理想国》
03191.name: 逻辑推理
03191.text:
Play only if you have at least 1 clue.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator either heals 2 horror or discards a [[Terror]] card from his or her threat area.
03191.textZh:
仅当你至少拥有1个线索才可打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员治愈2点恐惧或弃掉其威胁区域中的一张[[恐怖]]卡牌。

03192.name: 古代雕文
03192.text:
Researched. Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. For every 2 points you succeed by, discover 1 additional clue at your location.
03192.textZh:
研究完成。(FAQ，v2.0)使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：调查。你检定成功且每超过难度2点，发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。

03193.name: 古代雕文
03193.text:
Researched. Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. If you succeed, you may automatically evade an engaged enemy. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
03193.textZh:
研究完成。(FAQ，v2.0)使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：调查。如果你检定成功，你可以自动躲避一个与你交战的敌人。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

03194.flavor: "Aim for the eyes," they told me.
03194.flavorZh: “瞄准眼晴。”他们这么告诉我的。
03194.name: 暗中偷袭
03194.text: Fight. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
03194.textZh: 攻击。本次攻击将你的[agility]值加入你的技能值。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，自动躲避被攻击敌人。

03195.name: 扒窃
03195.text:
Fast.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card or gain 1 resource. If you succeeded by 2 or more, do both instead.
03195.textZh:
快速。
[reaction]在你躲避一个敌人后，横置扒窃：抽取1张卡牌或获得1资源。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，改为执行以上两项。

03196.name: 量子通量
03196.text: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and draw 1 card. Remove Quantum Flux from the game.
03196.textZh: 将你的弃牌堆洗入你的牌库并抽取1张卡牌。将量子通量从游戏中移除。

03197.name: 重新充能
03197.text: Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location and reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, discard the chosen asset. Otherwise, add 3 charges to the chosen asset.
03197.textZh: 选择你所在地点的一位调查员控制的一张[[法术]]或[[遗物]]支援，并从混乱袋随机揭示一个混乱标记。如果你揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，弃掉所选支援。否则，为所选支援增加3充能。

03198.name: 拉布兰奇夫人
03198.text:
[fast] If you have no cards in your hand, exhaust Madame Labranche: Draw 1 card.
[fast] If you have no resources, exhaust Madame Labranche: Gain 1 resource.
03198.textZh:
[free]如果你没有手牌，横置拉布兰奇夫人：抽取1张卡牌。
[free]如果你没有资源，横置拉布兰奇夫人：获得1资源。

03199.name: 诱捕陷阱
03199.text:
Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location.
Forced - After a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters attached location: Exhaust that enemy, disengage it from all investigators, and attach Snare Trap to it.
Forced - When attached enemy would ready: Instead, discard Snare Trap.
03199.textZh:
附属到你所在地点。每个地点仅限1张。
强制 - 在一个非[[精英]]敌人进入被附属地点后：横置该敌人，它与所有调查员解除交战，并将诱捕陷阱附属到它上。
强制 - 在被附属敌人将要重整时：改为弃掉诱捕陷阱。

03228.flavor: "Anderson's a hard-ass, sure. Always locking up the rum and waking us up at the crack of dawn. But out here in the middle of nowhere, he's definitely the one I want taking point."
03228.flavorZh: “安德森对手下确实狠。他平时把朗姆酒都锁起来，还经常天一亮就把我们叫起来。但现在，在这种不毛之地，我就希望他能打头阵。”
03228.name: 身先士卒
03228.text: If this skill test is successful, ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location and heal 1 damage or 1 horror from it.
03228.textZh: 如果本次技能检定成功，重整你所在地点的一个[[盟友]]支援并治愈其1点伤害或1点恐惧。

03229.name: 单打独斗
03229.text:
Play only as your first action.
Deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
03229.textZh:
只可作为你的第一个行动打出。
对与你交战的一个敌人造成1点伤害。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

03230.name: 急救
03230.text:
Uses (4 supplies). If First Aid has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset in your location.
03230.textZh:
使用(4补给)。如果急救没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]花费1补给：治愈你所在地点的一位调查员或一个[[盟友]]支援1点伤害和1点恐惧。

03231.name: 重大发现
03231.text: If this skill test is successful, the investigator performing this test searches the top 3 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.
03231.textZh: 如果本次技能检定成功，执行本次检定的调查员查找其牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。

03232.flavor: You know this town like the back of your hand.
03232.flavorZh: 你对这座小镇了如指掌。
03232.name: 捷径
03232.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to your location. Attached location gains:
"[fast] Exhaust Shortcut: Move (to a connecting location). Any investigator at this location may trigger this ability."
03232.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你所在地点。被附属地点获得：“[free]横置捷径：移动(到一个连接地点)。”位于该地点的所有调查员均可以触发此能力。(FAQ，v1.4)

03233.name: “吃我一招！”
03233.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
03233.textZh:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。作为将“吃我一招！”投入技能检定的额外费用，花费最多3资源。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，获得两倍数量的该资源。

03234.name: .41短口手枪
03234.text:
Uses (3 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 1 or more, this attack deals +1 damage. Once per turn, if you succeed by 3 or more, you may take an additional action this turn.
03234.textZh:
使用(3子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少1点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。每回合一次，如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。

03235.name: 力量洪流
03235.text:
As an additional cost to commit Torrent of Power to a skill test, spend up to 3 charges from among assets you control.
For each charge spent in this way, Torrent of Power gains [willpower] [wild].
03235.textZh:
作为将力量洪流投入技能检定的额外费用，从你控制的所有支援上花费最多3充能。
每以此方式花费1充能，力量洪流获得[willpower][wild]。

03236.name: 探知术
03236.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck, or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck, in any order. If a [[Terror]] or [[Omen]] card is among the looked-at cards, take 1 horror.
03236.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[free]横置探知术并花费1充能：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。将其以任意顺序放回该牌库顶。如果查看的卡牌中有[[恐怖]]或[[征兆]]卡牌，受到1点恐惧。

03237.flavor: "Is… is it over?" Her hands shook, and she fell to her knees. "Is it finally over?"
03237.flavorZh: “结……结束了吗？”她跪倒在地，双手颤抖不止，“终于结束了吗？”
03237.name: 中途伏击
03237.text: Choose an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and test [agility] (X), where X is that enemy's evade value. If you succeed, defeat that enemy.
03237.textZh: 选择你所在地点一个处于横置状态的非[[精英]]敌人并检定[agility](X)，其中X为该敌人的躲避值。如果你检定成功，击败该敌人。

03238.name: 不期而遇
03238.text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset with printed resource cost X in any player's discard pile. Put that asset into play under your control.
03238.textZh: 选择任意玩家弃牌堆中的一个印刷资源费用为X的[[盟友]]支援。将该支援放置入场，放到你的控制之下。

03239.flavor: You can never be too prepared.
03239.name: 应急物品
03239.text: Gain 4 resources or place 4 supply tokens among assets controlled by investigators at your location, or any combination thereof.
03239.textZh: 获得4资源或将4补给标记分配给你所在地点的调查员控制的支援(或以任意方式组合，总计4点)。

03263.name: 追猎行动
03263.text:
Fast. Play when you would draw an encounter card during the mythos phase.
Instead, search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy, spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location), and shuffle the encounter deck. If you cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
03263.textZh:
快速。在神话阶段期间你将要抽取一张遭遇卡牌时打出。
改为查找遭遇牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一个敌人，生成并与你交战（而非其通常的生成地点），并混洗遭遇牌库。如果你不能这么做，抽取遭遇牌库顶1张卡牌。

03264.name: 原定计划
03264.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
[reaction] Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for up to 3 different [[Tactic]] and/or [[Supply]] events, and attach them facedown to Stick to the Plan. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Stick to the Plan may be played as if they were in your hand. As an additional cost to play an attached card, exhaust Stick to the Plan.
03264.textZh:
永久。卓越。
[reaction]你抽取起始手牌前：查找你的牌库，找出最多3张不同的[[策略]]和/或[[供给]]事件，并将其正面朝下附属到原定计划。(FAQ，v2.0)混洗你的牌库。
附属到原定计划的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。作为打出一张附属卡牌的额外费用，横置原定计划。

03265.name: 指导
03265.text: Choose another investigator at your location who has yet to take his or her turn this round. That investigator may take an additional action during his or her turn this round.
03265.textZh: 选择你所在地点的另一位本轮尚未进行其回合的调查员。该调查员可以在本轮自己回合期间进行额外一次行动。

03266.name: 奥术洞察
03266.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[fast] While an investigator is taking his or her turn, spend 1 charge: Your location gets -2 shroud until the end of this turn. (Limit once per turn.)
03266.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[free]一位调查员进行自己的回合时，花费1充能：直到本回合结束，你所在地点的隐藏值-2。(每回合仅限一次。)

03267.name: 侥幸逃脱
03267.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy makes an attack of opportunity against you.
Cancel that attack. You get +2 skill value for the next skill test you perform this turn.
03267.textZh:
快速。在敌人对你进行趁乱攻击时打出。
取消该次攻击。本回合中你下次执行的技能检定得到技能值+2。

03268.name: 建议
03268.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Suggestion: Evade. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 charge from Suggestion.
[reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy would attack you, spend 1 charge: Cancel that attack.
03268.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]横置建议：躲避。本次躲避尝试将你的[willpower]值加入你的技能值。如果你未超过难度至少2点并成功，从建议移除1充能。
[reaction]在一个非[[精英]]敌人将要攻击你时，花费1充能：取消该次攻击。

03269.name: 圣胡伯的钥匙
03269.text:
You get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], and -2 sanity.
[reaction] When you would be defeated by horror, discard St. Hubert's Key: Immediately heal 2 horror.
03269.textZh:
你得到+1[willpower]，+1[intellect]和-2神智值。
[reaction]在你将要由于恐惧被击败时，弃掉圣胡伯的钥匙：立刻治愈2点恐惧。

03270.name: 守护结界
03270.text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at any location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.
03270.textZh:
快速。在位于任意地点的一位调查员抽取一张非弱点诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。然后，受到1点恐惧。

03271.name: 新晋术士
03271.text:
Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom or 2 horror on it.
[fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
03271.textZh:
强制 - 在新晋术士入场后：在上面放置1个毁灭标记或2点恐惧。
[free]横置新晋术士：查找你牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。

03272.name: “放马过来！”
03272.text:
Commit to a skill test only if you are engaged with an enemy.
For each enemy engaged with you, "Not without a fight!" gains [willpower] [combat] [agility].
03272.textZh:
有敌人与你交战才能投入到技能检定。
每有一个与你交战的敌人，“放马过来！”获得[willpower][combat][agility]。

03273.name: 求生高手
03273.text: Return 3 [[Innate]] skills from your discard pile to your hand.
03273.textZh: 将你弃牌堆中的3张[[天性]]技能返回你的手牌。

03304.name: “吃枪子吧！”
03304.text:
Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset.
You may spend X additional ammo tokens from that asset. When you reveal chaos tokens for this attack, reveal X additional chaos tokens. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest.
03304.textZh:
快速。在你激活[[枪械]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。
你可以花费该支援上的额外X子弹标记。在你为本次攻击揭示混乱标记时，额外揭示X个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。

03305.name: 阿登护甲
03305.text: [reaction] When damage is assigned to Armor of Ardennes, exhaust Armor of Ardennes: Cancel 1 of that damage.
03305.textZh: [reaction]在分配伤害给阿登护甲时，横置阿登护甲：取消该伤害中的1点。

03306.name: 遗觉记忆
03306.text: Play Eidetic Memory as an exact copy of an [[Insight]] event in any investigator's discard pile (including its resource cost). Remove that event from the game. Remove Eidetic Memory from the game instead of discarding it.
03306.textZh: 将遗觉记忆作为任意调查员弃牌堆中的一张[[洞察]]事件打出(包括其资源费用)。将该事件从游戏中移除。不要弃掉遗觉记忆，改为将其从游戏中移除。

03307.name: 殚精竭虑
03307.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.
03307.textZh:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库，找出一张卡牌，将其抽取，并混洗其牌库。

03308.name: 卡戎的银币
03308.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
When earning experience during the resolution of a scenario, if you were not defeated during that scenario, you earn 2 additional experience. If you were defeated during that scenario, you are killed.
03308.textZh:
永久。卓越。
在冒险结局期间取得经验值时，如果该次冒险期间你没有被击败，你取得额外2点经验。如果该次冒险期间你被击败，你阵亡。

03309.name: 短管猎枪
03309.text:
Uses (2 ammo).
Playing Lupara does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If Lupara entered play this turn, you get an additional +1 [combat] and deal an additional +1 damage for this attack.
03309.textZh:
使用(2子弹)。
打出短管猎枪不会触发趁乱攻击。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。这次攻击中你+1[combat]并造成+1伤害。如果短管猎枪是本回合入场的，你本次攻击得到额外+1[combat]并造成额外+1伤害。

03310.name: 死里逃生
03310.text:
Fast. Play when you would be defeated.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you, discard all cards in your threat area, heal 2 horror and 2 damage, and move to any revealed location with no enemies. If it is your turn, end your turn. Remove Cheat Death from the game.
03310.textZh:
快速。在你将要被击败时打出。
和与你交战的每个敌人解除交战，弃掉你威胁区域中的全部卡牌，治愈2点恐惧和2点伤害，并移动到任意一个没有敌人的已揭示地点。如果现在是你的回合，结束你的回合。将死里逃生从游戏中移除。

03311.name: 时间曲折
03311.text:
Fast. Play immediately after an investigator at your location finishes resolving an action during his or her turn.
Undo that action (return the game state to exactly the way it was before that action was performed, except for the playing of Time Warp and its costs).
03311.textZh:
快速。你所在地点的一位调查员在其回合期间结算完毕一次行动后立刻打出。
撤销该行动(游戏返回到该行动执行之前的状态，但仍然视作你打出了时间曲折，且该卡牌打出的费用不会返还)。(FAQ，v1.4)

03312.name: 远古印记封印
03312.text:
Do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag for this test. Treat the chaos token revealed for this test as an [elder_sign].
When this test ends, remove Seal of the Elder Sign from the game.
03312.textZh:
本次检定不要从混乱袋中揭示混乱标记。本次检定揭示的混乱标记视为[elder_sign]。
在本次检定结束时，将远古印记封印从游戏中移除。

03313.flavor: There's nothing in the headlines about the horrors you've witnessed. But the obituaries section is disturbingly long.
03313.flavorZh:
新闻头条里丝毫没有提到你目击的恐怖事件。
但讣告栏里的名字却多得让人心中发怵。
03313.name: 报纸
03313.text:
You get +2 [intellect] while investigating if you have no clues.
[reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location, if you have no clues: Discover an additional clue at your location.
03313.textZh:
你调查时如果没有线索，得到+2[intellect]。
[reaction]在你将要发现你所在地点的至少1个线索时，如果你没有线索：发现你所在地点的额外1个线索。

03314.name: 内讧
03314.text:
Fast. Play after the enemy phase begins.
Cancel all attacks made by non-[[Elite]] enemies against you this phase.
03314.textZh:
快速。敌军阶段开始后打出。
取消本阶段所有非[[精英]]敌人对你的攻击。

03315.name: 伊苏之匙
03315.subnameZh: 让暴风雨来的更猛烈些吧
03315.text:
You get +1 to each of your skills for each horror on Key of Ys.
Forced - When any amount of horror would be placed on you: Place 1 of that horror on Key of Ys.
Forced - When Key of Ys leaves play: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.
03315.textZh:
伊苏之匙上每有一点恐惧，你得到每项技能+1。
强制 - 在任意数量的恐惧将要放置到你身上时：将其中1点恐惧放置到伊苏之匙上。
强制 - 在伊苏之匙离场时：弃掉你牌库顶10张卡牌。

04001.backFlavor: Leo Anderson has spent his whole life getting into the deadliest and most obscure corners of the globe. Along the way, he's lost good people. He often questions whether such academic pursuits have been worth the lives lost. His most recent expedition, an ill-fated voyage to Nan Madol to recover <u>Olosopha's Almanac</u>, ended in complete disaster. Mitch was the only one of his people to survive, or at the very least, to remain human. Leo is sick of burying people who trusted him. But now he knows these expeditions aren't purely academic in nature - and he won't quit until the job is done.
04001.backFlavorZh: 里奥·安德森穷其一生，出入于地球上最为凶险、隐蔽之地。在这一路上，他曾失去伙伴。他常常质疑自己，这样的学术追求是否值得付出生命的代价。他最近一次探险是前往南马都尔寻找奥卢索尔历书，那是一场不幸的探险，结局简直是场灾难。他的探险小队只有米奇活了下来，或者换句话说，只有他仍保有人性。里奥再也不愿理葬伙伴的尸身，他们生前是那么信任里奥。但现在他知道探险并不仅是出于学术目的一一在完成使命之前，他绝不却步。
04001.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Mitch Brown, Bought in Blood, 1 random basic weakness.
04001.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：米奇·布朗、血的代价、1张随机基础弱点。
04001.flavor: "Keep moving. You can die on your own time."
04001.flavorZh: 继续前进。要死你就自己死去，别误了大伙。
04001.name: 里奥·安德森
04001.text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Play an [[Ally]] asset, reducing its cost by 1.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
04001.textZh:
[reaction]在你的回合开始后：打出一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌，其费用减1。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。查找你牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。

04002.backFlavor: Not many people can say that they've climbed a mountain on every continent. Fewer still can say they've stolen a golden idol from a tribe of cannibals. Among women in a male-dominated society, Ursula is unique in being able to make these sorts of claims. Ever since she was a small girl, Ursula has broken the rules set down for her, climbing trees, playing in the mud, exploring the woods, and doing plenty of other things that a "proper young lady shouldn't be doing." Since getting a degree in archaeology in Boston, she has been traveling the world searching for forgotten civilizations.
04002.backFlavorZh: 没多少人能说自己攀登过每一块大陆的高山，能说自己曾从食人族部落里偷走黄金神像的人就更少了。在男性占主导地位的社会中，厄休拉是唯一能够发出如此豪言的女性。当她还是个小女孩的时候，厄休拉就已打破了规限自己的条条框框，她爬树、在泥地里玩要、到森林里探索，做许多“年轻女孩不该做”的事情。在波士顿取得考古学学位后，她一直在世界各地找寻失落的文明。
04002.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, [[Relic]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jake Williams, Call of the Unknown, 1 random basic weakness.
04002.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，[[遗物]]卡牌等级0-4，中立卡牌等级0-5。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：杰克·威廉斯、未知的呼唤、1张随机基础弱点。
04002.flavor: "Discovery is easy. Understanding is the hard part."
04002.name: 厄休拉·唐斯
04002.text:
[reaction] After you move to a location: Take an investigate action. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. After this test ends, you may move to a connecting location.
04002.textZh:
[reaction]在你移动到一个地点后：进行一次调查行动。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。在本次检定结束后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。

04003.backFlavor: Prohibition was the best thing that ever happened to Finn Edwards. Until they banned alcohol, he was just drifting through life, doing odd jobs here and there. But afterward, the demand for alcohol rose to such a fever pitch that he was able to make a living evading the law and giving people what they wanted. His new lifestyle particularly suited his personality, providing him with a taste of danger and plenty of cash. He never got caught and never lost a delivery. Now he's wrapped up in some kind of supernatural conspiracy, but in the end, he adheres to the same principles: Deliver the goods. Don't get caught.
04003.backFlavorZh: 对于芬思·爱德华兹而言，禁酒令简直就是天赐良机。在实施禁酒之前，他的生活漂泊无定，到处打些零工。但在那以后，人们对酒精的渴望臻至狂热，他便通过规避法律来满足人们的需求，赖以为生。他崭新的活法恰恰与他的个性不谋而合，在刀尖上过活，赚得盆满钵满。他从来不会被抓，也不会弄丢一趟货。现在他被卷入了某种超自然的阴谋之中，但最终他还是坚守着一贯的原则：安全走货，免遭逮捕。
04003.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: [[Illicit]] cards level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 Seeker and/or Survivor cards ([seeker] and/or [survivor]).
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Smuggled Goods, Finn's Trusty .38, Caught Red-handed, 1 random basic weakness.
04003.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：[[违法]]卡牌等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5，其它的探求者和/或求生者卡牌([seeker]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：走私货物、芬恩可靠的.38手枪、当场抓获、1张随机基础弱点。

deckOptions.error: You cannot have more than 5 Seeker and/or Survivor cards

04003.flavor: "Never lose track of the exit. Or the merchandise."
04003.flavorZh: “别忘了给自己留条后路，也别把货给忘了”
04003.name: 芬恩·爱德华兹
04003.text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to evade.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each exhausted enemy in play. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at your location.
04003.textZh:
你可以在自己回合期间进行额外一个行动，该行动只能用于躲避。
[elder_sign]效果：场上每有一个处于横置状态的敌人，+1。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以发现你所在地点的1个线索。

04004.backFlavor: Mateo Castile's life has not been easy since he became a priest. Recent decades in Mexico have been wracked with instability and conflict. Father Mateo struggled to balance his faith with the pragmatic concerns of preaching when the law told him he must not. But this is not what has assaulted Mateo's faith at its core. The nearby murders and kidnappings were not politically motivated, as he had suspected. A gruesome and horrid cult thrives at the heart of the brewing war. How, Mateo wonders, could a kind and loving God allow what he saw that night to exist?
04004.backFlavorZh: 马泰奥·卡斯提尔自从成为神父后，日子一直不好过。近十年来，墨西哥深受动乱与冲突之苦。马泰奥神父一面希望守住自己的信仰，一面为了布道，有时不得不忽视法律，但这并不是马泰奥信仰动摇的主要原因。如他所料，周围发生的凶杀案和绑架案，其动机与政治因素无关。在这场精心酝酿的纷争背后，一个可怕而恐怖的邪教逐渐壮大。马泰奥想知道，仁慈而可亲的上帝怎能容许他那晚所见的事情发生呢？
04004.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, [[Blessed]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): The Codex of Ages, Serpents of Yig, 1 random basic weakness.
Bonus Experience: You begin the campaign with 5 additional experience (does not affect the number of weaknesses you must take in Standalone Mode).
04004.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，[[祝福]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：古代抄本、伊格蛇族、1张随机基础弱点。
额外经验值：剧本开始时你有额外5点经验值(这不影响你在单场冒险模式必须拿取的弱点数量)。
04004.name: 马泰奥神父
04004.text:
[reaction] When an investigator reveals an [auto_fail] chaos token: Cancel that token and treat it as an [elder_sign] token, instead. (Limit once per game.)
[elder_sign] effect: You automatically succeed. After this test ends, either (choose one):
 - Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
 - If it is your turn, you may take an additional action this turn.
04004.textZh:
[reaction]在一位调查员揭示[auto_fail]混乱标记时：取消该标记并改为将其视作[elder_sign]标记。(每场游戏仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：你检定自动成功。在本次检定结束后，选择一项：
- 抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。
- 如果此时是你的回合，你本回合可以进行额外一次行动。

04005.backFlavor: Sometimes, life gives you a choice: accept the lot that is given to you or stand up for who you are and what you believe. Calvin chose the latter. On the edge of death, bleeding out on the side of a dirt road, he received a vision - a terrifying vision of the Earth, sundered, and João, the love of his life, turning to ash in the vortex of a blazing inferno. Then, Calvin made another choice. He reached out to the darkness and pulled it within him. He would not die, not today. The world needed him. João needed him.
04005.backFlavorZh: 有的时候，生活会让你做选择：接受被安排的命运，或者为自我和信仰而坚持。加尔文选择后者。当他倒在泥路边上，血流不止，濒临死亡时，他看见了幻象一一地球变得四分五裂，令人胆颤，而他的毕生挚爱一一乔亚在熊熊烈火的旋涡之中化为灰烬。随后，加尔文做了另一个决定。他伸手触及黑暗，将其引入自己体内。他不会死，至少今天不会。世界需要他，乔亚也是。
04005.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, [[Spirit]] cards level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Until the End of Time, Voice of the Messenger, 1 random basic weakness.
04005.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，[[勇气]]卡牌等级0-3，中立卡牌等级0-5。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：时间尽头、信使之声、1张随机基础弱点。
04005.flavor: "If you hurt him, I'll kill you."
04005.name: 加尔文·怀特
04005.text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect] for each horror on you.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility] for each damage on you.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. You may either heal 1 damage or horror, or take 1 direct damage or direct horror.
04005.textZh:
你身上每有一点恐惧，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
你身上每有一点伤害，你得到+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
[elder_sign]效果：+0。你可以治愈1点伤害或恐惧，或受到1点直接伤害或直接恐惧。

04006.flavor:
"You ain't going nowhere without me, Leo.
So you might as well tell me what's going on."
04006.flavorZh: “你得带上我，里奥，所以不妨跟我说说发生了什么事。”
04006.name: 米奇·布朗
04006.text:
Leo Anderson deck only.
You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold non-unique allies.
04006.textZh:
里奥·安德森牌库专用。
你拥有额外2个盟友槽位，只可以用来携带非独特盟友。

04007.flavor: We paid a terrible price for the knowledge we sought. Was it worth it?
04007.flavorZh: 我们为自己获得的知识付出了惨痛的代价。那值得吗？
04007.name: 血的代价
04007.text: Revelation - You must either discard an [[Ally]] asset you control from play, or discard each [[Ally]] asset from your hand. If no assets are discarded by this effect, shuffle Bought in Blood back into your deck.
04007.textZh: 显现 - 你必须从场上弃掉你控制的一张[[盟友]]支援卡牌，或弃掉手牌中的所有[[盟友]]支援。如果没有因本效果弃掉的支援，将血的代价洗回你的牌库。

04008.name: 杰克·威廉斯
04008.text:
Ursula Downs deck only.
The first move or investigate action you perform each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Jake Williams: Draw 1 card.
04008.textZh:
厄休拉·唐斯牌库专用。
你每回合执行的第一个移动或调查行动不会触发趁乱攻击。
[reaction]在你揭示一个地点或放置一个新的地点入场后，横置杰克·威廉斯：抽取1张卡牌。

04009.name: 未知的呼唤
04009.text:
Revelation - Put Call of the Unknown into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the beginning of your turn: Choose a location other than your location. When your turn ends, if you did not successfully investigate the chosen location this turn, take 2 horror and shuffle Call of the Unknown back into your deck.
04009.textZh:
显现 - 将未知的呼唤放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
强制 - 当你的回合开始时：选择你所在地点以外的一个地点。在你的回合结束时，如果本回合你没能成功调查所选地点，受到2点恐惧并将未知的呼唤洗回你的牌库。

04010.name: 走私货物
04010.text:
Finn Edwards deck only.
Play only if there are no ready enemies at your location.
Search either your discard pile or the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Illicit]] card and draw it. If you searched your deck, shuffle Smuggled Goods into your deck.
04010.textZh:
芬恩·爱德华兹牌库专用。
你所在地点没有处于重整状态的敌人才能打出。
查找你的弃牌堆或你牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一张[[违法]]卡牌并将其抽取。如果你查找了你的牌库，将走私货物洗入你的牌库。

04011.flavor: It was an old gun - battered, scraped, and well used - but it had never let him down.
04011.flavorZh: 这是一把旧枪——有磨损与划痕，用了好一阵子——但这杆枪从来没让他失望。
04011.name: 芬恩可靠的.38手枪
04011.text:
Finn Edwards deck only. Fast. Uses (3 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is not engaged with you, you deal +1 damage for this attack.
04011.textZh:
芬恩·爱德华兹牌库专用。快速。使用(3子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果被攻击敌人未与你交战，你本次攻击造成+1伤害。

04012.name: 当场抓获
04012.text: Revelation - Ready each enemy at your location or a connecting location. Each hunter enemy at a connecting location moves 1 location toward you. If no enemies move as a result of this effect, shuffle Caught Red-Handed back into your deck.
04012.textZh: 显现 - 重整你所在地点或一个连接地点的所有敌人。连接地点上的每个猎手敌人向你移动1个地点。如果没有敌人以此效果移动，将当场抓获洗回你的牌库。

04013.name: 古代抄本
04013.text:
Father Mateo deck only. Seal ([elder_sign]).
You get +1 [willpower] while there is a token sealed here.
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, discard The Codex of Ages: Resolve the [elder_sign] token that was sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag (instead of revealing a token from the chaos bag).
04013.textZh:
马泰奥神父牌库专用。封印([elder_sign])。
有标记被封印在此时，你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]在你将要从混乱袋中揭示一个混乱标记时，弃掉古代抄本：结算封印在此的[elder_sign]标记，如同刚刚从混乱袋中揭示该标记(而不是从混乱袋中揭示一个标记)。

04014.flavor: "I know not what Yig is, but I know I have wounded his children." - Father Mateo, <u>Investigators of Arkham Horror</u>
04014.flavorZh: “我不知道伊格是什么，但我知道我伤了它的子嗣。”马泰奥神父，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》
04014.name: 伊格蛇族
04014.text:
Prey - Father Mateo only.
Hunter.
Revelation - Search the chaos bag for the [elder_sign] chaos token and seal it on Serpents of Yig.
04014.textZh:
猎物 - 仅限马泰奥神父。
猎手。
显现 - 从混乱袋中查找[elder_sign]混乱标记并将其封印在伊格蛇族上。

04015.flavor:
Unyielding, uncompromising,
he stood resolute in defiance of his fate.
04015.flavorZh: 他坚决反抗自己的命运，不屈不挠，永不妥协。
04015.name: 时间尽头
04015.text:
Calvin Wright deck only.
Direct damage and direct horror may be assigned to Until the End of Time.
04015.textZh:
加尔文·怀特牌库专用。
直接伤害和直接恐惧可以被分配到时间尽头上。

04016.name: 信使之声
04016.text:
Revelation - You must either (choose one):
 - Take 1 direct damage and suffer 1 physical trauma.
 - Take 1 direct horror and suffer 1 mental trauma.
04016.textZh:
显现 - 你必须(选择以下一项)：
- 受到1点直接伤害并承受1点肉体创伤。
- 受到1点直接恐惧并承受1点精神创伤。

04017.name: 求生匕首
04017.text:
[action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack.
[reaction] After an enemy attack deals damage to you during the enemy phase, exhaust Survival Knife: Fight. This attack targets the attacking enemy. You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
04017.textZh:
[action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]在敌军阶段期间，在敌人的攻击对你造成伤害后，横置求生匕首：攻击。本次攻击以刚刚发起攻击的敌人为目标。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]并造成+1伤害。

04018.name: 冒险家
04018.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Venturer: Place 1 supply or ammo on an asset controlled by an investigator at your location.
04018.textZh:
使用(3补给)。
[free]花费1补给并横置冒险家：在你所在地点一位调查员控制的一个支援上放置1补给或子弹。

04019.name: 肝胆相照
04019.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Ally]] asset you control.
Attached asset gets +1 health and +1 sanity.
04019.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你控制的一个[[盟友]]支援。
附属的支援得到+1生命值和+1神智值。

04020.name: 值得信赖
04020.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Item]] asset you control.
While resolving a triggered ability on attached asset, you get +1 to each of your skills.
04020.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你控制的一个[[道具]]支援。
结算附属的支援上的触发能力时，你得到每项技能+1。

04021.name: 爱丽·霍洛维兹博士
04021.text:
[reaction] After Dr. Elli Horowitz enters play: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Relic]] asset and attach it to her. Shuffle your deck.
Each [[Relic]] asset attached to Dr. Elli Horowitz does not take up any slots (it is still considered to be in play and under your control).
04021.textZh:
[reaction]在爱丽·霍洛维兹博士入场后：查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出一张[[遗物]]支援卡牌，将其附属到爱丽·霍洛维兹博士上。混洗你的牌库。
附属在爱丽·霍洛维兹博士上的每张[[遗物]]支援卡牌均不占用任何槽位(这些卡牌仍视为在场上并由你控制)。

04022.name: 古代巨石
04022.text: [action]: Investigate. Your location gets +3 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location, discard Ancient Stone, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the stone." Next to this, in parentheses, record the difficulty of this skill test.
04022.textZh: [action]：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值+3。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点额外1个线索，弃掉古代巨石，并在剧本日志中记录“你鉴定了古代巨石”。在记下的文字旁边以括号形式记录下本次技能检定难度。

04023.name: 埃兹特里之牙
04023.text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility] while resolving an ability on a treachery card.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test while resolving an ability on a treachery card, exhaust Tooth of Eztli: Draw 1 card.
04023.textZh:
结算诡计卡牌上的能力时，你得到+1[willpower]和+1[agility]。
[reaction]在你结算诡计卡牌上的能力时技能检定成功后，横置埃兹特里之牙：抽取1张卡牌。

04024.name: 发掘古物
04024.text: Investigate. Choose a [seeker] asset in your hand. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the chosen asset's printed cost. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, put the chosen asset into play. If that asset has the [[Relic]] trait, draw 1 card.
04024.textZh: 调查。选择你手中的一张[seeker]支援卡牌。本次技能检定难度等于所选支援的印刷费用。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为将该所选支援放置入场。如果该支援有[[遗物]]特性，抽取1张卡牌。

04025.name: 寻宝猎人
04025.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either pay 1 resource or discard Treasure Hunter.
04025.textZh:
你得到+1[intellect]。
强制 - 当补给阶段结束时：你必须支付1资源或弃掉寻宝猎人。

04026.name: 彩饰骷髅
04026.text:
Uses (0 charges).
[reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token bank) on Decorated Skull, as a charge.
[action] Spend 1 charge: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
04026.textZh:
使用(0充能)。
[reaction]在你所在地点有调查员、[[盟友]]支援或敌人被击败后：在彩饰骷髅上放置1资源(从供应堆拿取)，作为充能。
[action]花费1充能：抽取1张卡牌并获得1资源。

04027.name: 窃听
04027.text: Choose an unengaged enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the evade value of the chosen enemy. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location.
04027.textZh: 选择你所在地点的一个未处于交战状态的敌人。检定[intellect](X)，其中X为所选敌人的躲避值。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点的2个线索。

04028.name: “交给你了！”
04028.text:
Fast. Play after you draw a non-peril encounter card, but before resolving that card's effects.
Choose another investigator. That investigator is considered to have drawn that encounter card instead. Gain 1 resource.
04028.textZh:
快速。在你抽取了一张非险境遭遇卡牌后，结算该卡牌效果前打出。
选择另一位调查员。改为视为该调查员抽取了该遭遇卡牌。获得1资源。

04029.name: 拉莱耶迷雾
04029.text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, after evading the chosen enemy, you may move to a connecting location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, choose and discard a card from your hand.
04029.textZh:
使用(4充能)。
[action]花费1充能：躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，在躲避所选敌人后，你可以移动到一个连接地点。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，从你手牌中选择并弃掉一张卡牌。

04030.flavor: It was left behind for a purpose.
04030.flavorZh: 它的留存必定出于某种目的。
04030.name: 钻地魔虫之石
04030.text:
Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]).
Forced - After you reveal an [auto_fail] symbol during a skill test: Return The Chthonian Stone to your hand.
04030.textZh:
封印([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。
强制 - 你在技能检定中揭示[auto_fail]符号后：将钻地魔虫之石返回你的手牌。

04031.name: 保护咒语
04031.text:
Group limit 2 copies of Protective Incantation in play.
Seal (any except [auto_fail]).
Forced - At the end of your turn: You must either spend 1 resource or discard Protective Incantation.
04031.textZh:
团队仅限2张保护咒语在场。
封印(除了[auto_fail]以外的任何标记)。
强制 - 当你的回合结束时：你必须花费1资源或弃掉保护咒语。

04032.flavor: The secrets were written in the stars.
04032.name: 黑暗预言
04032.text:
Fast. Play when you would reveal a chaos token.
Reveal 5 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens with a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol to resolve, and ignore the rest. (If no such token is revealed, choose any one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.)
04032.textZh:
快速。在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时打出。
改为揭示5个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中1个带有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号的标记结算并忽略其余标记。(如果没有揭示上述标记，从这些标记中选择任意一个标记结算，忽略其余标记。)

04033.name: 临时武器
04033.text:
You may play Improvised Weapon from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects.
Fight. The attacked enemy gets -1 fight for this attack. (If you played Improvised Weapon from your discard pile, this attack deals +1 damage.)
04033.textZh:
你可以从你的弃牌堆中打出临时武器。如果你这么做，结算效果后将其洗入你的牌库。
攻击。被攻击敌人本次攻击得到-1攻击值。(如果你从弃牌堆中打出了临时武器，本次攻击造成+1伤害。)

04034.name: 狗屎运
04034.text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less during an evasion attempt against a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Place that enemy on top of the encounter deck.
04034.textZh:
快速。你对非[[精英]]敌人进行躲避尝试期间，技能检定失败且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
将该敌人放到遭遇牌库顶。

04035.name: 雅沃托
04035.text:
[fast] Exhaust Yaotl: During this skill test, you get a bonus to each skill equal to the number of matching skill icons on the top card of your discard pile (not counting [wild] icons).
[fast]: Discard the top card of your deck. (Limit once per phase.)
04035.textZh:
[free]横置雅沃托：在本次技能检定期间，你每项技能得到加成，加成的点数等于你弃牌堆顶上的一张卡牌的对应技能图标数([wild]图标不计算在内)。
[free]：弃掉你牌库顶的一张卡牌。(每阶段仅限一次。)

04036.name: 殊死一搏
04036.text:
Commit only to a skill test with no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test.
Last Chance loses [wild] for each card in your hand.
04036.textZh:
在一次未投入其他卡牌的技能检定中，才能投入本卡牌。该次技能检定不能投入其他卡牌。
你手牌中每有一张卡牌，殊死一搏失去[wild]。

04037.name: 背包
04037.text:
[reaction] After Backpack enters play: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards, and attach them facedown to Backpack. Shuffle your deck.
Cards attached to Backpack may be played as if they were in your hand. If there are no cards attached to Backpack, discard it.
04037.textZh:
[reaction]在背包入场后：查找你牌库顶的6张卡牌，找出最多3张非弱点[[道具]]或[[供给]]卡牌，正面朝下附属到背包上。混洗你的牌库。
附属到背包的卡牌可以被打出，如同其在你手中。如果没有卡牌附属在背包，弃掉背包。

04038.name: 黑暗契约
04038.text:
Campaign Mode only.
Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location.
Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if Dark Pact is still in your hand: Remove Dark Pact from your deck. Search the collection for The Price of Failure and add it to your deck.
04038.textZh:
剧本模式专用。
对你所在地点的一位调查员造成2点伤害。
强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果黑暗契约仍在你手牌中：将黑暗契约从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出失败的代价，并将其加入你的牌库。

04039.name: 失败的代价
04039.text: Revelation - Take 2 damage and 2 horror. Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance). Remove The Price of Failure from your deck. Search the collection for Dark Pact and place it in your discard pile.
04039.textZh: 显现 - 受到2点伤害和2点恐惧。在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记(本效果能导致当前密谋推进)。将失败的代价从你的牌库中移除。查找收藏，找出黑暗契约，并将其放入你的弃牌堆。

04040.name: 厄运降临
04040.text:
Campaign Mode only.
Revelation - Take 1 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "doom approaches." If this was already recorded, remove Doomed from your deck, search the collection for Accursed Fate, and place it on the bottom of your deck.
04040.textZh:
剧本模式专用。
显现 - 受到1点恐惧。在剧本日志中，你的调查员取得的剧情支援/弱点下方，记录“厄运降临”。如果已经有此条记录，将厄运降临从你的牌库中移除，查找收藏，找出被诅咒的命运并将它放到你的牌库底。

04041.name: 被诅咒的命运
04041.text: Revelation - Take 2 horror. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record that "the hour is nigh." If this was already recorded, remove Accursed Fate from your deck, search the collection for The Bell Tolls, and place it on the bottom of your deck.
04041.textZh: 显现 - 受到2点恐惧。在剧本日志中，你的调查员取得的剧情支援/弱点下方，记录“时间到”。如果已经有此条记录，将被诅咒的命运从你的牌库中移除，查找收藏，找出丧钟敲响并将它放到你的牌库底。

04042.flavor:
It is meant for you.
It always has been.
04042.flavorZh:
丧钟为你而鸣。
一如既往。
04042.name: 丧钟敲响
04042.text: Revelation - The hour of your demise has arrived. You are killed.
04042.textZh: 显现 - 你的死期到了。你阵亡了。

04103.name: 犯罪现场
04103.text:
Play only as your first action.
Discover 1 clue at your location (2 clues instead if there is an enemy at that location). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
04103.textZh:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索(如果该地点有敌人，改为发现2个线索)。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

04104.name: 枪法如神
04104.text:
Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] or [[Ranged]] asset.
This attack can target an enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack. If this attack succeeds against an enemy not engaged with you, the attack deals +1 damage.
04104.textZh:
快速。在你激活[[枪械]]或[[远程]]支援上的攻击能力时打出。
本次攻击可以选择一个连接地点上的一个敌人作为目标。本次攻击忽略冷漠和反击关键词。如果本次攻击的敌人未与你交战，且你攻击成功，本次攻击造成+1伤害。

04105.name: 劝服
04105.text: Parley. Choose a non-weakness [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location and test [intellect] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is that enemy's horror value. If you succeed, shuffle the chosen enemy into the encounter deck. If the chosen enemy is [[Elite]], automatically evade it instead.
04105.textZh: 谈判。选择你所在地点的一个非弱点[[类人]]敌人并检定[intellect](3)。本次检定得到+X难度，X等于该敌人的恐惧值。如果你检定成功，将所选敌人洗入遭遇牌库。如果所选敌人为[[精英]]，改为自动躲避它。

04106.name: 老练分析
04106.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
Anytime you upgrade a card with the (Unidentified) or (Untranslated) subtitle, you may upgrade a second copy of that card at no experience cost. If you do, the two upgraded versions are chosen at random from among the eligible options. (You must still meet all deckbuilding restrictions.)
04106.textZh:
永久。每套牌库仅限1张。
每当你升级带有(未鉴定)或(未翻译)副标题的卡牌时，你可以多升级1张同名卡牌，无需花费经验值。如果你这么做，从符合条件的选项中随机选择该卡牌的两张升级版本。(你仍需满足所有的牌库构建限制。)

04107.flavor: "It’s not really all that lucky. Just in the mood for a smoke."
04107.flavorZh: “其实没那么幸运，只是想抽根烟。”
04107.name: 幸运烟盒
04107.text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.
04107.textZh: [reaction]你在一次技能检定中成功且超过难度2点或更多后，横置幸运烟盒：抽取1张卡牌。

04108.flavor: "Don’t worry. I know a guy." - Leo De Luca
04108.flavorZh: “别担心，我认识一个人。”里奥·德·卢卡
04108.name: 销赃贩子
04108.text: [reaction] When you play an [[Illicit]] card during your turn, exhaust Fence: The [[Illicit]] card gains fast. If it was already fast, reduce its cost by 1 instead.
04108.textZh: [reaction]你在你的回合期间打出[[违法]]卡牌时，横置销赃贩子：该[[违法]]卡牌获得快速。如果该卡牌已有快速，改为降低其费用1点。

04109.name: 奥术研究
04109.text:
Permanent.
When you purchase Arcane Research, suffer 1 mental trauma.
After each scenario of a campaign, reduce the experience cost of the first [[Spell]] card you upgrade before the next scenario by 1.
04109.textZh:
永久。
在你购买奥术研究时，承受1点精神创伤。
在一个剧本的每个冒险结束后，在下一场冒险之前，你升级的第一张[[法术]]卡牌经验值费用减1。

04110.name: 反击法术
04110.text:
Fast. Play when a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] chaos token is revealed during a skill test at your location.
Cancel that chaos token. (Do not reveal a new chaos token to replace it.)
04110.textZh:
快速。在你所在地点的技能检定期间揭示[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]混乱标记时打出。
取消该混乱标记。(不揭示新的混乱标记以替换。)

04111.flavor: Calloused hands and a determined heart were all she needed.
04111.flavorZh:
她只需要一双长满茧子的手，
还有一颗坚定的心。
04111.name: 坚韧不拔
04111.text:
Fast. Play when you are assigned damage and/or horror that would defeat you.
Cancel up to 4 of that damage and/or horror.
04111.textZh:
快速。在你将被分配伤害和/或恐惧，且其数值足够击败你时打出。
取消该伤害和/或恐惧中的最多4点。

04112.name: 晕眩重击
04112.text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
04112.textZh: 如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，自动躲避被攻击敌人。

04149.name: 恢复元气
04149.text:
Play only as your first action.
Heal 1 damage (2 instead if you drew a treachery this round). Then, draw 1 card.
04149.textZh:
只能作为你的第一个行动打出。
治愈1点伤害(如果你本轮抽取了一张诡计卡牌，改为治愈2点伤害)。然后，抽取1张卡牌。

04150.name: 占据先机
04150.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
Take the Initiative loses [wild] for each action that has been completed by any investigator this phase.
04150.textZh:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
任意调查员在本阶段每完成一个行动，占据先机失去[wild]。

04151.name: 准备万全
04151.text: [fast] Exhaust Well Prepared: Choose an asset you control. You get +X skill value for this skill test, where X is the number of matching skill icons on the chosen asset.
04151.textZh: [free]横置准备万全：选择你控制的一张支援卡牌。你本次技能检定得到+X技能值，X为所选支援上对应的技能图标数量。

04152.flavor:
“How do you know I’m mad?” said Alice.
“You must be,” said the Cat, “or you wouldn’t have come here.”
- Lewis Carroll, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
04152.flavorZh:
“你怎么知道我是疯的？”爱丽丝说。
“你肯定疯了。”柴郡猫说，“不然你不会到这儿来。”路易斯·卡罗尔，《爱丽丝梦游仙境》
04152.name: 去伪存真
04152.text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Place 2 secrets on an asset you control.
04152.textZh:
你所在地点有线索才能打出。
在你控制的一张支援卡牌上放置2秘密。

04153.name: 参透真谛
04153.text:
Commit only to a skill test from an ability printed on a scenario card.
If this skill test is successful, discover 1 clue at your location.
04153.textZh:
只能投入冒险卡牌上印刷能力中的技能检定。
如果本次技能检定成功，你发现你所在地点的1个线索。

04154.name: 一目十行
04154.text: [fast] Place 1 of your clues on your location and exhaust Quick Study: You get +3 skill value for this skill test.
04154.textZh: [free]将你的1个线索放到你所在地点并横置一目十行：你本次技能检定得到+3技能值。

04155.flavor: Only someone who is half seas over would lather up the O’Bannions.
04155.flavorZh: 喝多了的人才会主动找欧巴尼恩的茬。
04155.name: 职业杀手
04155.text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the next time the evaded enemy takes damage this turn, deal it 1 additional damage.
04155.textZh: 如果在躲避尝试期间进行本技能检定，且检定成功，则在本回合中，成功躲避的该敌人下次受到伤害时，对其造成额外1点伤害。

04156.flavor: The higher the stakes, the better his luck.
04156.name: 挥金如土
04156.text: [fast] Spend 3 resources and exhaust High Roller: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. If you succeed, gain 3 resources.
04156.textZh: [free]花费3资源并横置挥金如土：你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。如果你检定成功，获得3资源。

04157.flavor: Voyaging far from our placid island of ignorance.
04157.flavorZh: 远远地驶离我们那名为无知的平静小岛。
04157.name: 如痴如醉
04157.text: If this skill test is successful during an investigation, place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control.
04157.textZh: 如果调查期间本次技能检定成功，在你控制的一张支援卡牌上放置1充能或秘密。

04158.name: 追忆未来
04158.text: [reaction] When a skill test you are performing begins, if Recall the Future is ready, name a chaos token: If the named chaos token is revealed during this skill test, exhaust Recall the Future. Then, you get +2 skill value for this skill test.
04158.textZh: [reaction]在你正在执行的技能检定开始时，如果追忆未来处于重整状态，指定一个混乱标记：如果本次技能检定期间揭示了指定的混乱标记，横置追忆未来。然后，你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。

04159.name: 反复尝试
04159.text:
Uses (3 tries). If Try and Try Again has no tries, discard it.
[reaction] After a skill test is failed, if a skill card you own is committed to that test, exhaust Try and Try Again and spend 1 try: Return that skill card to your hand.
04159.textZh:
使用(3次数)。如果反复尝试没有次数，弃掉本卡牌。
[reaction]在技能检定失败后，如果有投入到该检定的技能卡牌归你所有，横置反复尝试并花费1次数：将这些技能卡牌中的一张返回你的手牌。

04160.flavor: Bravery is born when there is no other choice.
04160.flavorZh: 面临绝境之时，勇气油然而生。
04160.name: 围困
04160.text: [fast] Discard 1 card from your hand: You get +2 skill value for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
04160.textZh: [free]弃掉你1张手牌：你本次技能检定得到+2技能值。(每次检定仅限一次。)

04192.name: 英勇无畏
04192.text:
If this skill test is successful, add Intrepid to your play area as an asset with the text:
"You get +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Intrepid."
04192.textZh:
如果本次技能检定成功，将英勇无畏加入你的游戏区域，作为一张带有以下文字的支援卡牌：
“你得到+1[intellect]、+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
强制 - 当一轮结束时：弃掉英勇无畏。”

04193.name: 特制弹药
04193.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Place 2 ammo on that asset. Limit 1 per asset.
Attacks performed by attached asset deal +1 damage against [[Monster]] enemies.
04193.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
附属到你所在地点的一位调查员控制的[[枪械]]支援上。在该支援上放置2子弹。每个支援仅限1张。
附属的支援对[[怪物]]敌人执行攻击时造成+1伤害。

04194.flavor: It always points where you don't want to go.
04194.flavorZh: 它总是指向你不愿去的地方。
04194.name: 异界罗盘
04194.text: [action] Exhaust Otherworldly Compass: Investigate. Your location gets -X shroud for this investigation. X is the number of revealed locations connected to your location.
04194.textZh: [action]横置异界罗盘：调查。本次调查你所在地点的隐藏值-X。X为与你所在地点相互连接、且已揭示的地点数量。

04195.name: 暴露弱点
04195.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you succeed, treat that enemy's fight value as if it were 0 for the next attack performed against it this phase. Draw 1 card.
04195.textZh:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一个敌人。检定[intellect](X)，其中X等于该敌人的攻击值。如果你检定成功，本阶段下次对该敌人执行的攻击中，将该敌人的攻击值视为0。抽取1张卡牌。

04196.flavor:
"My line of work encounters a lot of so-called 'curses.'
It is a topic I would rather not discuss."
04196.flavorZh: “我从事的行业会碰上许多所谓的‘诅咒”。我不想讨论这个话题。”
04196.name: 萝拉·桑提亚哥
04196.text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
[fast] Exhaust Lola Santiago and spend X resources: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.
04196.textZh:
你得到+1[intellect]和+1[agility]。
[free]横置萝拉·桑提亚哥并花费X资源：发现你所在地点的1个线索。X为你所在地点的隐藏值。

04197.flavor: You must invest yourself in every spell. Sometimes literally.
04197.flavorZh:
你必须对每种法术全情投入。
有时就是字面的意思。
04197.name: 奥利芙·麦克布莱德
04197.text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.
04197.textZh: [reaction]在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时，横置奥利芙·麦克布莱德：改为揭示3个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中2个标记结算，并忽略其余标记。

04198.name: 逆反
04198.text: Ignore the effects of all [skull], [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] symbols during this test (including their modifiers).
04198.textZh: 忽略本次技能检定期间所有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]和[elder_thing]符号的效果(包括其修正值)。

04199.name: 危险预感
04199.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Put Premonition into play, reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag, and seal it on Premonition.
Forced - When a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag, instead. Then, discard Premonition.
04199.textZh:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
将危险预感放置入场，从混乱袋中随机揭示一个混乱标记，并将其封印在危险预感上。
强制 - 在将要从混乱袋中揭示一个混乱标记时：改为结算封印在此的标记，如同刚刚从混乱袋中揭示该标记。然后，弃掉危险预感。

04200.name: 学无止境
04200.text:
Fast. Play after a skill test you failed ends (after resolving all effects from the failed test).
Attempt that test again. You get +2 skill value for this test.
04200.textZh:
快速。在你技能检定失败且完毕后(结算该次技能检定的所有效果后)打出。
再次尝试该次检定。你本次检定得到+2技能值。

04201.name: 重拾信念
04201.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Take Heart to any type of test.
If this test fails, the performing investigator draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources.
04201.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你可以将重拾信念投入任意类型的检定。
如果本次检定失败，执行检定的调查员抽取2张卡牌并获得2资源。

04202.name: 勇斗异劫
04202.text:
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test with a difficulty higher than your base skill value.
Reveal X additional chaos tokens for this skill test. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.
04202.textZh:
快速。在你执行一次技能检定，且检定难度高于你的基础技能值时打出。
本次技能检定额外揭示X个混乱标记。选择其中一个结算并忽略其余标记。X为本次检定难度和你基础技能值的差值。

04203.flavor:
Roland loosened his tie, tilted his hat, and turned up his coat collar, and when he was sure he looked respectably disreputable, he approached the door.
- Graeme Davis, <u>The Dirge of Reason</u>
04203.flavorZh: 罗兰松开了他的领带，帽子弄得歪斜，翻起大衣的领子，将自己的模样弄得邋里邋遢才去开门。格里姆·戴维斯，《理性的挽歌》
04203.name: 战壕大衣
04203.textZh: 你在躲避尝试期间得到+1[agility]。

04204.name: 华饰弓
04204.text:
Uses (1 ammo). Limit 1 ammo on Ornate Bow.
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [agility] and deal +2 damage for this attack.
[action]: You nock another arrow. Place 1 ammo on Ornate Bow.
04204.textZh:
使用(1子弹)。华饰弓上仅限1子弹。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。你本次攻击得到+2[agility]并造成+2伤害。
[action]：你重新搭上一支箭。在华饰弓上放置1子弹。

04229.name: 1918勃朗宁自动步枪
04229.text:
Uses (8 ammo).
[action] Spend 1-5 ammo: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage. X is the amount of ammo spent as part of this ability's cost.
04229.textZh:
使用(8子弹)。
[action]花费1-5子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+X[combat]。本次攻击不造成其基础伤害，改为造成X点伤害。X为作为本能力的费用花费的子弹数量。

04230.name: 古代巨石
04230.text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."
[reaction] When you draw any number of cards, spend that many secrets: Deal that much damage to an enemy at your location.
04230.textZh:
研究完成。使用(X秘密)。X为“你鉴定了古代巨石”旁括号内的数字。
[reaction]在你抽取任意数量的卡牌时，花费等量的秘密：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成等量的伤害。

04231.name: 古代巨石
04231.text:
Researched. Uses (X secrets). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have identified the stone."
[reaction] When you draw any number of cards, spend that many secrets: Heal that much horror from a card at your location.
04231.textZh:
研究完成。使用(X秘密)。X为“你鉴定了古代巨石”旁括号内的数字。
[reaction]在你抽取任意数量的卡牌时，花费等量的秘密：治愈你所在地点的一张卡牌的等量恐惧。

04232.name: 悄然遁去
